lines.text: The root is Fer! Transfer, refer.
Did you know? Fer is Latin for carry.
Quick quiz! Which means back plus carry?

words.ex: I'll transfer the money to your account today.
Please refer to page ten for more details.

publish.title: Fer root: transfer and refer
